subject: Mutual plan — starter draft, ownership & close-window options
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan — starter draft, ownership & close-window options

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a starter Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for you to review. I captured the milestones we discussed, suggested owners from our side, and a couple of timeline options so we can decide the target close window.

Attached: Novus_MAP_starter_draft.xlsx (single-sheet starter MAP). I also created a living copy of the plan here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bNovusMAPstarter

High-level recap (from today):
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + secure embeddings for search.
- Key constraints: PHI handling, SSO (SAML), and <12 month retention for PII-derived vectors.
- Success criteria: 90% reduction in triage time for clinicians in pilot; latency SLA <= 500ms for conversational flows.

Starter MAP (milestones, tentative owner, dependencies):
1) Kickoff & alignment (owner: Novus IT) — dependency: confirm stakeholders and SSO contact
2) Security & data flow review (owner: Novus Security / Redwood Security team) — dependency: security questionnaire and sample data schema
3) Pilot integration (owner: Redwood CS / Marcus) — dependency: SSO test account, sample dataset
4) Pilot validation & metrics (owner: Novus Clinical Ops / Dana) — dependency: pilot data collection window (2–3 weeks)
5) Contract/Procurement sign-off (owner: Novus Legal / Priya) — dependency: final pricing and standard T&Cs
6) Production rollout (owner: Novus Eng + Redwood infra) — dependency: capacity provisioning and backup/retention policy

Target close-window options (pick one):
- Aggressive: 2 weeks (target close Jul 14) — assumes procurement & legal are greenlighted quickly and security review completed in parallel
- Standard: 6 weeks (target close Aug 11) — allows time for security review, PO processing, and a short 2-week pilot

Asks from our side: please confirm the internal stakeholders for IT, Security, Clinical Ops, and Legal (I put placeholders below) and let us know which close-window you prefer. Also flag any procurement or compliance reviewers we should loop in now.

Suggested next step: 30-min MAP kickoff to lock the roster and choose target close date. I proposed a few times in the attached calendar options — if Jul 5–7 works for you we'll lock in.

Thanks again,

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — good recap and thanks to the team for pulling the starter draft together. Quick notes from my side:
- Stakeholders: Alex Mercer (IT / integration lead), Priya Shah (Legal), Dana Lowe (Clinical Ops). I will also add Chris Bowen (Head of Data) to the distribution once we finalize the kickoff.
- Dependencies: Security will need the questionnaire and a sample schema — Priya will coordinate with Security and loop in our vendor intake team.
- Preferred close window: Standard — Aug 11. That gives us room for a 2-week pilot + procurement timeline.

I can do a kickoff on Jul 5 at 10:00 AM PT — please send a calendar invite. We'll bring Priya and Dana and aim to confirm owners and next steps in that meeting.
